consequence.statement: A UI bugfix for creating apps whose destination sets both name and server; operators have no required action.

assertion.statement: The Argo CD 3.0.0 UI fixes a bug that stopped users from adding an application whose destination sets both name and server; operators do not need to do anything.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: A UI-only bugfix; no configuration key, field, flag or endpoint is named that fits a subject family; change: The evidence only gives the bugfix title; it does not say how the UI handled such destinations before or after the fix; applicability: Exposure depends on how users interact with the UI, and no configuration predicate shows that
